name: Beef Tea
description: Historical recipe from Miss Leslie's Complete Cookery (1851). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: lean fresh juicy beef
ingredients.originalText: one pound of lean fresh juicy beef

instructions.text: Cut a pound of the lean of fresh juicy beef into small thin slices and sprinkle them with a very little salt
Put the meat into a wide-mouthed glass or stone jar closely corked
Set it in a kettle or pan of water, which must be made to boil and kept boiling hard round the jar for an hour or more
Take out the jar and strain the essence of the beef into a bowl

source.author: Eliza Leslie
source.originalInstructions:
1. Cut a pound of the lean of fresh juicy beef into small thin slices and sprinkle them with a very little salt
2. Put the meat into a wide-mouthed glass or stone jar closely corked
3. Set it in a kettle or pan of water, which must be made to boil and kept boiling hard round the jar for an hour or more
4. Take out the jar and strain the essence of the beef into a bowl
